kurzfassung: Comedians Kevin Ryan and H. Foley from the Are You Garbage podcast are featured guests. The discussion covers their background and comedic style. Additionally, several news items are reviewed.

Gal Gadot on the use of AI in filmmaking
beschreibung:
Kevin Ryan and H. Foley are the comedians behind the popular Are You Garbage? podcast, where they interview comedians and celebrities about their bizarre, trashy, and hilarious upbringing stories. The Philadelphia-born duo has built a devoted following with their blunt, blue-collar humor and undeniable chemistry. Check out their new special, American Garbage, dropping September 13 on their YouTube channel.
IN THE NEWS: A copycat case emerges in the Lindsay Clancy trial, Bill Simmons is under investigation by the Massachusetts Gaming Commission, and Gal Gadot defends the use of AI in filmmaking.
